title: Compliance-Gap Probe Suite for Alignment Faking

original_idea.body: # Compliance-Gap Probe Suite for Alignment Faking. Use released Alignment Faking Revisited classifiers to measure the compliance gap across several open instruct models; report which show a gap and scaling.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Standardized compliance-gap suite for the most-studied scheming behavior; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses released classifiers + prompted setting on open models; accessible, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused suite across several models; some classifier-integration plumbing.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Replication/extension benchmark for open models; third-party value.

novelty.reasoning: Alignment Faking Revisited already covers many models; suite is mostly repackaging.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Existing work covers the compliance gap across models; suite is mostly repackaging.
